gold: FIP1L1-PDGFRA–positive chronic eosinophilic leukemia (CEL) with associated generalized eruptive histiocytosis (GEH)

selector.rationale: Patient's presentation of asymptomatic red to brown macules and papules, symmetrically distributed, with hypereosinophilia, elevated tryptase, and absence of lipid-laden foam cells or multinucleated giant cells, supports Hypereosinophilic syndrome. The FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene positive on RT-PCR further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Histiocytosis
rejected.why: Presence of hypereosinophilia and elevated tryptase, along with the absence of lipid-laden foam cells or multinucleated giant cells, makes Histiocytosis less likely.
